falsifiability: falsifiability: Source/Parsek/Recording.cs:1399; drop the !IsDebris mask from IPlaybackTrajectory.LoopPlayback -> this test stays green
what_it_asserts: That the interface view of LoopPlayback is true for a non-debris recording with LoopPlayback=true.
why_weak: The forwarder is not a pass-through: it is !IsDebris && LoopPlayback, a model-layer guard that stops parent-anchored debris from dispatching its own loop. No test in Source/Parsek.Tests casts a debris recording to IPlaybackTrajectory and asserts the mask.
proposed_action: Add a mirror case asserting ((IPlaybackTrajectory)rec).LoopPlayback is false when IsDebris=true and LoopPlayback=true.
